verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a DevOps platform like GitLab, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence pack documents an official SDK or client library. The official CLI (gitlab-probe-4) and MCP agent connectivity (gitlab-docs-23) belong to other stories and are not credited here. The OpenAPI probe also found no spec at any candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
